# @trysac/openapi-diff

> Diff two OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 documents and classify each change as breaking, warning or info using ten rules, as a library and a CI command line tool. TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example, API, CLI and rules
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules, boundaries and the diff pipeline
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test files, fixtures and commands
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model with defended and undefended cases

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and effort metrics
